latest_final: The man voluntarily entered a coffin for a planned buried-coffin escape stunt, knowing there was a corpse inside but not knowing whose it was. When he struck a match and recognized the body, he realized that the deceased was supposed to remove the earth covering the coffin and could no longer do so. He was never dug out and died trapped underground. The recognition made him understand that the planned escape had failed; the clues do not establish a single precise physical cause of death or fully explain why no one else rescued him.
